data.name: Houman
data.gender_notes: Houman is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root h-w-m, meaning 'man' and 'wisdom'. In Islamic history, Houman is the name of a wise and righteous man who lived during the time of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name Houman carries the meaning “Man of wisdom” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Houman usually hope their child will grow to embody man of wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of wisdom and knowledge in the service of God.
data.etymology: Houman belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Man of wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Houman total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
